# Followup CRM Integration

May 7, 2024

Table of contents

## Already using Followup CRM to manage your leads?

Followup CRM has developed an integration using [Hover's public API](https://developers.hover.to/reference/welcome) so you can push job data to Hover when it's time to create estimates.

For details of how to set up the integration, click below to watch a 1 min video or visit [their help center](https://support.followupcrm.com/knowledge/hover-integration).

#### **Integration Setup \| Step-by-step guide**

[![](https://downloads.intercomcdn.com/i/o/1043236016/28f1f5fe20b58c3e0bb86e66/followup+with+drop+shadow.png?expires=1794342600&signature=21e445fe7aafa565e9ae17b567c5a14c65ea4855b46b9cfe66e913bb17c87f40&req=dSAjFct9m4FeX%2FMW1HO4zaJIvuRz%2B5LloXR3JIuA2QYnIXbD%2Fd%2Fvyah3fRDa%0A1tFRRKN4A6xbAlE3SVo%3D%0A)](https://support.followupcrm.com/knowledge/hover-integration)

[Schedule a demo with FollowupCRM](https://www.followupcrm.com/request-live-demo)

### **Need help? Reach out to the FollowupCRM team.**

If you encounter issues with this integration, we recommend reaching out directly to the FollowupCRM team for the fastest resolution.

Click the **help** button in the bottom right corner of your Followup account. Their team will be informed and can assist in real time, or reach out by phone or email:

- Phone: 945-906-9665

- Email: [info@followupcrm.com](mailto:info@followupcrm.com)
